content.comment_body: Hello, In this document [url], I found the stated maximum transistor output frequency is 10Hz. Is this correct, or could it be an error? It seems quite low for a transistor output.
The manual does indicate 10Hz, but I'm not entirely certain.

Thanks for your reply. Is there anyone else with hands-on experience regarding transistor outputs? My goal is to generate a frequency reference for a VFD using a digital output from [product_name] to produce pulse signals, instead of using analog modules.

While I only have experience with relay outputs rather than transistor outputs on [product_name], I have sometimes experimented with the PWM function block. For instance, I set the pulse/pause ratio at 1:1 (500 of 1000 units) and used a period time of 0.02 seconds. In that case, the relay switching was audible and the connected LED stayed mostly lit. Reducing the period time to its minimum (0.01 seconds) stopped the relay from switching entirely. According to the manual, actual frequency for transistor outputs depends on the cycle time. This makes it difficult to provide exact details; knowing your program's cycle time would be necessary.

analysis.insight_summary: There is user confusion regarding the documented 10Hz maximum transistor output frequency for [product_name] modules, as many feel this seems low for typical applications. Uncertainty exists about whether the documentation is accurate or if there is an error. The conversation highlights that the realistic frequency limit depends on specific conditions, such as program cycle time. Users are seeking more precise explanations to guide their use of pulsed signals with this hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the maximum transistor output frequency to be higher and are looking for clarification on documentation accuracy. They want clear and practical guidance about the real-world frequency limits achievable with [product_name] transistor outputs.
